DSSSB TGT Result 2026 Out @dsssb.delhi.gov.in

The DSSSB Trained Graduate Teacher Recruitment examination 2026 is a state-level test held to select candidates for the post of trained graduate teacher across various schools. The selection process includes two primary stages: a 200-mark computer-based test (CBT) and document verification. It is to be noted that candidates are selected purely on merit, determined by their combined score in the CBT. Soon after the completion of the exams, candidates were eagerly waiting for the announcement of their results, so this is to inform them that the Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB) has declared the DSSSB TGT Results for Hindi, Natural Science and Special Education subjects. 

DSSSB TGT Special Education Result 2026

The Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board has released the marks for the DSSSB TGT (Special Education Teacher) recruitment under Post Code 33/23. A total of 581 vacancies were notified, and the Computer-Based Test (CBT) was conducted on 24th, 26th and 27th June 2025. Based on the examination performance, 1,076 candidates have been provisionally shortlisted to upload their documents through the E-dossier module. Candidates can check their marks by logging into the OARS portal, while the final selection will be made after document verification and fulfillment of eligibility conditions.

How to Check DSSSB TGT Scorecard 2026 at dsssb.delhi.gov.in?

All those candidates who appeared for the DSSSB TGT recruitment examination can access their online scorecards by visiting the official website and following the detailed step-by-step process shared below:

Step 1: Visit the official website of the Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB), i.e., dsssb.delhi.gov.in.

Step 2: Click on the Latest Updated tab.

Step 3: Now search for the DSSSB TGT Result 2026 PDF download link.

Step 4: The page will redirect you to the login window.

Step 5: Carefully enter your respective application number, password/date of birth, and security PIN.

Step 6: Once the details are filled successfully, click on the ‘submit’ option.

Step 7: Check all the details mentioned on the TGT score cards.

Step 8: At the end, make sure you download and save your respective DSSSB TGT Result 2026 PDF for future use.

DSSSB TGT Result 2026: FAQs

Q1. When is the DSSSB TGT Result 2026 announced?

Answer: The DSSSB TGT results have been announced on 29th May 2026 on the official website of the Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB).

Q2. How can I check my DSSSB TGT merit list 2026?

Answer: Candidates can check and download their online DSSSB TGT Merit List PDF by logging in to the official DSSSB website using their respective login credentials.

Q3. What is the next step after the announcement of the DSSSB TGT Result 2026?

Answer: After the announcement of the DSSSB TGT Result 2026, shortlisted candidates must upload documents (marksheets, certificates, category certificates, etc.) within a specified period.

Q4. What details are required to download the DSSSB TGT scorecard 2026?

Answer: To check and download the DSSSB TGT result 2026, candidates are required to enter their respective application number, password/date of birth, and security PIN.
